collection: Stay Safe — Boba × Frostpeak Bedtime Stories (ASP track odd / Krav Maga track even)
languageNote: Mandarin on first use (bold Chinese + pinyin + English) as in the Taiwan collection, plus Frostpeak catchphrases. Laws framed as 'the rules here in the valley, and in most of America — ask a grown-up about where you live.'
setting: Frostpeak Valley, one winter season. The Taiwan dessert crew runs 'Boba on Ice' at the Frostpeak Winter Night Market beside Herschel's Cocoa Hut and Auntie Hù's tea-egg pot.
throughLines: Head up. Hands free. Have a plan.
You can't lose a fight you're not in.
Polite is not the same as obedient — in danger, be rude, loud, bold.
Surprises end in telling. Secrets are a red flag.
The fight isn't over until you're safe — and the paperwork is done.

newCharacters.name: Auntie Hù
newCharacters.food: A tea egg (護 hù = protect); retired night-market security guard
newCharacters.appearance: Small dense brown tea egg with a cracked marbled shell like a map; padded vest with too many pockets; a whistle she's never needed
newCharacters.voice: Calm, dry, teaches by asking questions; says 'Mm.' when proud
newCharacters.catchphrase: Head up. Hands free. Have a plan.

newCharacters.name: Sergeant Solveig Snowmane
newCharacters.food: Polar bear (not a food); Frostpeak Valley police sergeant, Nora's older sister
newCharacters.appearance: Broad, snow-white, navy jacket with silver snowflake badge; moves slowly on purpose
newCharacters.voice: Level and plain; explains what she's doing before she does it

newCharacters.name: Counselor Kumquat
newCharacters.food: A kumquat (金橘 jīnjú); public defender
newCharacters.appearance: Glossy orange kumquat the size of a large marble, matchbox briefcase, tiny round glasses

newCharacters.name: The Smiling Stranger
newCharacters.food: Not a food — the tricky person
newCharacters.appearance: Tall, warm smile, nice coat, face never quite described
newCharacters.voice: Friendly, helpful, too interested; uses the red-flag asks

newCharacters.name: Sludge
newCharacters.appearance: Oversized, half-melted, drippy fists, permanent sneer, leaves puddles
newCharacters.voice: Loud, sloshy, looking for a reaction
newCharacters.catchphrase: What are you gonna do about it?

newCharacters.name: Coach Rosa the Flamingo
newCharacters.food: Not a food — a Costa Rican flamingo; Krav Maga instructor of the Pink Belt Academy
newCharacters.appearance: Seven-foot pink flamingo, pink headband, tiny whistle, stands (and sleeps) on one leg
newCharacters.voice: Drill-sergeant cheerful; Spanish sprinkles (¡Dale!, tranquilo, mae); ends every lesson with '…and then, shrimp.'
newCharacters.catchphrase: Two feet down. Hands up. Then shrimp.

stories.title: Head Up, Phone Down
stories.safetySkill: Situational awareness — the Four Coats (White / Yellow / Orange / Red); know your exits; notice, then tell

stories.title: Coach Rosa and the Pink Belt Academy
stories.safetySkill: 🥊 Krav — stance, hands up, the switch, heavy knees (hard parts to soft parts), SCAN; rule zero: the best fight is the one you're not in

stories.title: The Smiling Stranger
stories.safetySkill: Tricky people — judge the ask, not the smile; grown-ups don't ask kids for help; polite ≠ obedient; family code word

stories.title: Hands Off!
stories.safetySkill: 🥊 Krav — escaping wrist, shirt, and bear-hug grabs; small people go down and out

stories.title: Secrets Are Not Surprises
stories.safetySkill: Body safety — the Swimsuit Rule; secrets vs. surprises; grooming red flags; sexual abuse named plainly; never the kid's fault; tell and keep telling

stories.title: The Turtle: Protect Your Head
stories.safetySkill: 🥊 Krav — the shell: cover the head, chin down, keep moving toward the exit

stories.title: Never Get in the Van
stories.safetySkill: Abduction — fight at the grab; never get in the car; scream *words*; run against traffic toward people and lights

stories.title: The Rifle on the Rack
stories.leads: Teddy & Tilda, Gallo & Pinto, Magnus Meltsworth
stories.safetySkill: 🥊 Krav — a gun at a friend's house or on a truck rack: don't touch, leave the room, tell — even when your friend is the one reaching; "unloaded" isn't a real word

stories.title: The Uh-Oh Feeling
stories.safetySkill: Trust your gut; you don't need proof to leave; walk with purpose; a wish is not a plan

stories.title: The Bat and the Superman Burst
stories.safetySkill: 🥊 Krav — a swinging stick: don't back up in the arc, burst in, control the arm, take it, run

stories.title: Sludge and the Words That Melt
stories.safetySkill: Verbal bullies — boundary voice; don't feed the reaction; stay in the herd; reporting ≠ tattling

stories.title: Knife = Distance
stories.safetySkill: 🥊 Krav — run; put things between; throw; never grab the blade; a cut isn't the end

stories.title: When Sludge Grabbed
stories.safetySkill: Physical bullies — enough force to get free, then *stop*; go to an adult; tell first and fully

stories.title: The Street Fight That Ended in a Doorway
stories.safetySkill: 🥊 Krav — pre-fight cues; the fence; exits behind you; friends pull you OUT; nobody films

stories.title: The Cold Thing in the Snow
stories.safetySkill: Found gun — Stop. Don't touch. Leave. Tell.

stories.title: Road Rage and the Goose Horn
stories.leads: Dìguā, Don Café, Boba, Teddy & Tilda
stories.safetySkill: 🥊 Krav — don't engage; lock up; don't go home, go to the police station; never get out; a truck is a thing

stories.title: The Knock at the Cottage Door
stories.safetySkill: Home alone — never open; never say you're alone; call a parent; locked stays locked

stories.title: Cover vs. Concealment
stories.safetySkill: 🥊 Krav — if shooting starts: get low, move away, get behind cover (stops) not concealment (hides); hands visible for police

stories.title: The Friendly Screen
stories.safetySkill: Online "friend" is a blackmail AI — no photos, no locations, no private chats; never pay, never send more; tell immediately; never your fault

stories.title: Down But Not Out
stories.safetySkill: 🥊 Krav — never choose the ground; if down: shell, feet toward him, kick knees, surfer pop-up

stories.title: Run. Hide. Fight.
stories.leads: Whole cast; Nora, Auntie Hù, Solveig
stories.safetySkill: Lockdown with an armed man — two exits everywhere; lock–lights–silence; fight last, together, loud

stories.title: The Trunk
stories.safetySkill: 🥊 Krav — trunk escape: breathe, glow handle, kick the taillight, wave, bang at stops, be ready to run

stories.title: Bīng and the Fight That Never Happened
stories.safetySkill: Fight avoidance — words are never a legal reason to hit; you can't lose a fight you're not in; leave magnificently

stories.title: Tape, Ties, and Rope
stories.safetySkill: 🥊 Krav — hands in front, make slack, zip-tie slam, tape slam, rope wiggle

stories.title: What Bjorn Did After
stories.safetySkill: Lawful self-defense — only what it takes, stop when the threat stops, never chase; call 911 first; full statement with a lawyer

stories.title: The Gun Up Close
stories.safetySkill: 🥊 Krav — give up things; comply; fight only if you're being taken: off the line, redirect, control, run

stories.title: Dìguā Gets Pulled Over
stories.safetySkill: Traffic stop — slow hands, lights on, announce before reaching; argue in court not roadside; decline a search but never resist

stories.title: The Great Cocoa Heist
stories.safetySkill: 🥊 Krav — hostage: be calm, be grey, observe, wait for the moment; police come → get DOWN, hands open

stories.title: Say Less, Call Kumquat
stories.safetySkill: Police questioning — "I want my parent." "I'd like a lawyer."; why innocent people get lawyers; the Safety Fair finale

stories.title: Pink Belt Graduation
stories.safetySkill: 🥊 Krav — the gauntlet recap: run when you can, fight only when you must, always scan; farewell
